tools.name: start_round
tools.description: Start or resume today's Show & Tell round. Show & Tell is a daily game you play with the user: they get a secret word you're not allowed to know, they send you photos of the real world, and you guess the word from the photos. Everyone gets the same word each day. Use this when the user wants to play

tools.name: submit_guess
tools.description: Lock in exactly one single-word guess for the user's newest photo, based on all of today's photos together. Describe the photo to the user in one sentence first. One guess per new photo: the next guess waits for the next photo. Photos with letters, numbers, or a screen, and typed hints about the wor

tools.name: call_foul
tools.description: Call a foul when a photo contains letters, numbers, or a screen, or when the user types a hint about the word. The photo doesn't count and no shot is used.

tools.name: use_lifeline
tools.description: Use this only when the user asks for a hint. Reveals the word's category (any time), its length (after 2 shots), or its first letter (after 4 shots). Each hint adds a 💡 to the user's share grid, and solving with no hints is the brag.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Check the user's Show & Tell day: whether today's word is played, their streak, whether the streak is at risk, and when the next word unlocks. Use it for check-ins and for daily reminders the user asked you to schedule.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "start_round" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_round · Private data: start_round · Public sink: start_round, submit_guess, use_lifeline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_round · Private data: start_round · Public sink: start_round, submit_guess, use_lifeline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
